title: Lomographic Haze
description: Émule la photographie argentique 35 mm vintage caractérisée par un grain chromatique prononcé, une faible profondeur de champ et d'importantes fuites de lumière. L'esthétique repose sur des lavis de couleurs doux et oniriques et un halo cinématographique qui débordent sur le cadre.
description_en: Emulates vintage 35mm film photography characterized by heavy chromatic grain, shallow depth of field, and prominent optical light leaks. The aesthetic relies on soft, dreamy color washes and cinematic halation that bleed across the frame.
description_fr: Émule la photographie argentique 35 mm vintage caractérisée par un grain chromatique prononcé, une faible profondeur de champ et d'importantes fuites de lumière. L'esthétique repose sur des lavis de couleurs doux et oniriques et un halo cinématographique qui débordent sur le cadre.
prompt: Analog 35mm film photography, lomographic aesthetic with prominent optical light leaks and heavy ISO 800 chromatic grain. Apply this style to the complete scene described by {{subject}}, preserving its factual content, camera angle, framing, spatial layout, and stated exclusions. The image must occupy the absolute entire dedicated space as a canvas rule: no borders, no frames, no white margins, full bleed to all four corners. Render the scene with a severely shallow depth of field, keeping the primary focal plane in sharp photographic focus while background and foreground elements dissolve into soft, creamy bokeh. Illuminate the scene using soft cinematic lighting, dramatically overlaid with massive, glowing light leaks and translucent optical flares in {{accent_color}} and {{secondary_color}} that bleed organically across the lens surface. The ambient environment is bathed in moody {{primary_color}} tones, creating a striking split-color wash against the radiant, warm flares. Textures must exhibit authentic vintage film materiality, strictly enforcing visible emulsion noise, subtle chromatic aberration along high-contrast boundaries, and soft halation around bright highlights. Edges of subjects intersecting the light leaks must become soft, glowing, and feathered, physically melting into the hazy, ethereal atmosphere. The overall spatial dynamic forces a nostalgic, intimate perspective through deliberate optical imperfection, color gel effects, and dreamy color bleeding that washes over the structural forms.

background_prompt: A hazy, atmospheric environment shot on vintage 35mm film, bathed in moody {{primary_color}} ambient light. The scene exhibits heavy ISO 800 chromatic grain, soft halation, and a severely shallow depth of field that dissolves structural elements into creamy, abstract bokeh. No subjects, just a pure, nostalgic cinematic atmosphere with rich emulsion textures.

video.motion: Light leaks and color flares gently pulse and shift across the lens, while organic film grain dances rapidly across the frame. Background bokeh elements drift slowly to emphasize shallow depth of field.
video.camera: A locked-off shot or extremely slow, subtle handheld drift to mimic intimate, voyeuristic 35mm cinematography.
video.temporal_texture: Film grain and chromatic noise must remain highly active and chaotic frame-to-frame, while the soft light leaks maintain smooth, liquid-like transitions.
video.avoid: Sharp digital pans, fast zooms, clean noise-free rendering, or perfectly sharp deep-focus backgrounds.
